title: melaleuca scabrida
intro: Melaleuca scabrida, commonly known as the rough-barked paperbark, is a plant species native to Australia. It has been utilized for its potential health benefits, including antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Melaleuca scabrida are attributed to its ability to exhibit antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory effects, making it useful for wound care and skin issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include terpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
